module: Flowgraph node 'Camera Transform' (repeat_instant category, file cameraAngle). Gives the position (vec3), rotation (quat) and field of view (degrees) of the current camera via core_camera. pos and rot are only computed if their output pin is used.

C.desc: Flowgraph node class (created by _flowgraph_createNode(C)). The methods are called by the flowgraph manager or the editor.

work.desc: fov = core_camera.getFovDeg(); pos = getPosition():toTable() and rot = getQuat():toTable() if the pins are used.
